**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- Nothing in the agreement binds Bluefly to exclusivity, sole-sourcing, or minimum/all-requirements purchasing. Hits for "exclusive"/"sole" are all unrelated: tax-exclusive charges (§ 4.3), the exclusive-warranties disclaimer (§ 5.2), nonexclusive license grants (§§ 5.4, 12.1), and "sole discretion" usages (including our own termination right in § 13.1).
- § 14.16 (Freedom of Action) affirmatively states "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others," which preserves our freedom to procure equivalent hosting services elsewhere.
- This sits at the playbook's preferred position, so no edit is warranted.
